title: Anti-LGI1 Encephalitis: Treatable Mimic
subtitle: A commonly misdiagnosed autoimmune condition that mimics Alzheimer's but is treatable.
key_concept: Anti-LGI1 autoimmune encephalitis is a treatable cause of cognitive decline often misdiagnosed as Alzheimer's.
visual_metaphor: A dark cathedral interior with a single amber-lit stained glass window showing a brain with a key unlocking a lock, geometric patterns around.
why_it_matters: Opens a new diagnostic pathway for reversible dementia, shifting from hopeless prognosis to actionable treatment.
zone_change: New capability added: treatable dementia mimic identified in the diagnostic landscape.
